entities.summary: Gibran Latif Hamdan is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback in the National Football League (NFL) and NFL Europe. He was selected by the Washington Redskins in the seventh round of the 2003 NFL draft. He played college football for the Indiana Hoosiers. Hamdan was also a member of the Amsterdam Admirals, Los Angeles Avengers, Seattle Seahawks, San Francisco 49ers, Miami Dolphins, Buffalo Bills and Toronto Argonauts. He is the first person of Pakistani descent to play in the NFL.
